headline: No possible claim can satisfy these three clauses at once.
plain_english_why: Exclusion 4(f) applies only to claims where the Insured FAILED to maintain the Minimum Security Standards. Endorsement 7 restores coverage only for claims where the Insured MAINTAINED them — and the definition of Minimum Security Standards ("maintained continuously") makes maintaining and failing to maintain mutually exclusive. So every claim Endorsement 7 would give back was never excluded in the first place. The set of claims it restores is empty: the carveback is illusory. The policy reads as if Endorsement 7 broadens coverage; it broadens nothing.
